questions.citations: Line 12, Editing: "Users can update a shared note."
questions.issue: The specification does not define how concurrent saves are handled. The decision determines whether an update may overwrite another user's changes and how concurrent editing is tested.
questions.question: What should happen when two users save changes to the same note concurrently?
choices: The second save is rejected, and the user must review the newer version.
The most recent save replaces the earlier version.
